original_hook: Most 70% altcoin pumps look like single-candle wicks that bleed straight back to baseline. $LSK is showing a different technical signature. That pause converted former resistance into a demand floor before a secondary surge pushed toward $0.7079 on 14.2M USDT combined volume. 📊 LSK 1H: price $0.6711 • support $0.3412 • resistance $0.7079 • TP1 $0.799575 • target $0.89125 • SL / invalidation $0.3412 (long bias). Levels are chart-derived scenarios, not guarantees. The friction is overhead distribution. Rejection from $0.7079 back to $0.6669 left an upper wick on the hourly chart, occurring right as BTC (-1.3%) pulls back. What confirmation on $LSK would make you treat this setup as real rather than an early headline move?
